name: Damoh

queries.query: Damoh Madhya Pradesh official cadastral parcel map land records GIS site:gov.in
queries.result: First-party discovery found the official District Damoh Government of Madhya Pradesh government-links page, which identifies MP Bhu-Abhilekh and MP Bhu-Naksha, the district Revenue Administration page, the district revenue/land-records directory, DILRMP Damoh map-digitization status, and the national NAKSHA viewer. No anonymous Damoh parcel feature response was returned by discovery.

queries.query: दमोह मध्य प्रदेश आधिकारिक भू अभिलेख कैडस्ट्रल पार्सल मानचित्र GIS
queries.result: First-party Hindi discovery found the official Hindi District Damoh site and Hindi email directory, identifying the Superintendent of Land Records, Damoh tehsil/revenue contacts, and the same MP Bhu-Abhilekh/Bhu-Naksha links. It also found the official DILRMP Damoh status pages; no public Damoh parcel polygon response was found.

freshResearch.method: Separate English and Hindi first-party discovery followed by bounded anonymous TLS-verified GET requests. No credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe fields, or TLS disablement were used.

portalsFound.observation: Official District Damoh page links MP Bhu-Abhilekh and MP Bhu-Naksha as government land-record/map services.

Official district directory identifies the Superintendent of Land Records (SLR), Land Records, Damoh, and Damoh tehsil revenue office contacts; this is local registry-custodian evidence, not parcel geometry.
Official district administration page lists Damoh revenue division/tehsil and 1,229 revenue villages.
Official DILRMP Damoh district status route reports cadastral-map, georeferencing, RoR-linkage and parcel-status columns; programme status is not an open feature service.
Official national NAKSHA viewer landing page loaded and describes GIS-integrated urban/peri-urban land records, but anonymous Damoh parcel layer/schema access was not exposed.

requests.assessment: Loaded. Page links to http://www.landrecords.mp.gov.in/ and http://www.mpbhuabhilekh.nic.in/bhunakshaweb/; links alone did not expose a parcel API.
Anonymous TLS-verified request timed out after 15 seconds. No viewer configuration, schema, CRS, native ID or geometry obtained; not evidence of cadastral absence.
Request failed at DNS resolution for www.mpbhuabhilekh.nic.in. No redirect, schema, CRS, native ID or geometry obtained; not evidence of cadastral absence.
Loaded official Damoh map-digitization/geo-referenced/ULPIN status. It exposes aggregate/status tables, not an anonymous parcel feature response.
Loaded official Damoh tehsil village-level digitization status. It reports cadastral map progress for villages, not parcel geometry or a safe native parcel ID API.
Loaded official Madhya Pradesh district-level map-progress report containing Damoh aggregate rows. No parcel feature service was exposed.
Viewer HTML and current main.js loaded anonymously. No authenticated state selection, MP service URL, public schema, CRS, native ID or geometry response was obtained without login or private tokens.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Damoh district local land-record custody, MP Bhu-Abhilekh/Bhu-Naksha links, DILRMP Damoh cadastral-status routes and public NAKSHA viewer discovery.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Local registry custodian and cadastral-programme status were verified; no anonymous Damoh parcel geometry coverage was verified.

remainingUncertainty: The MP Bhu-Abhilekh/Bhu-Naksha current route, API schema, CRS, authorization, native parcel identity, city/tehsil coverage and update currency remain unresolved. The exact WUP point [23.8313048693427, 79.4398232960335] was preserved in latitude/longitude order and never shifted. No exact-point hit/miss inference was made.
